Castivio is a media player for content you already have. It plays playlists and streams that you add yourself, or that you obtain from a service provider you have chosen and pay separately. Castivio is not a content service and is not affiliated with any provider.

A Castivio licence permits use of the application on the device it was issued to. It is bound to that device and cannot be transferred, resold or shared. The licence covers the application only and grants no right to any channel, film, series or stream.

The Castivio application, its name, its interface and its source code are protected by copyright and remain the property of their owner. Castivio includes the Inter and IBM Plex Sans Arabic typefaces under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. All other trademarks, names and content belong to their respective owners.

Castivio has no user accounts and asks for no personal details. Your playlists, your provider credentials and what you watch are stored on this device and are not sent to Castivio. The identifiers shown on the licence screen are used only to issue and verify a licence for this device.

The application never processes a payment. Licences are bought through the Castivio activation portal, and any refund is requested and settled there under the terms shown at the time of purchase. Anything paid to a content provider is that provider\'s own and is outside Castivio\'s control.

Support is provided through the Castivio activation portal. Quote the device key shown on the licence screen: it identifies this device and says nothing about you. Castivio cannot help with a content provider\'s service, credentials or billing.

Using Castivio means accepting the terms on this page. If you do not accept them, do not use the application. A future version may update these terms, and the version in force is always the one shown here.

Castivio is a media player application only. It does not provide, host, broadcast, sell or distribute any channels, movies, series, live streams or media content. All content is supplied exclusively by the user or the user’s chosen service provider. Users are solely responsible for ensuring they have the legal rights to access and use their content. Castivio assumes no responsibility for the availability, legality, licensing or quality of any third-party content or services.
